text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, it's Curren Chan's Make Debut 
race. Expecting her to be nervous, she 
seems completely at ease instead, even 
posting selfies to social media.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she herself seemed full of 
motivation... And so,
Curren Chan took her 
first step toward reaching the pinnacle
of cuteness!
